description: This file implements a custom Android View called GameView that manages a simple joystick-based physics game. It handles input from multiple game controllers, manages game entities such as ships, bullets, and obstacles, and performs game loop updates including movement, collision detection, and rendering. The code includes inner classes for game objects with methods for drawing, updating position, and handling destruction animations.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: Custom View for the joystick-based game, implementing input device listener and handling game logic.

methods.name: findControllersAndAttachShips
methods.description: Scans input devices and attaches ships to controllers detected as gamepads or joysticks.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Resets game state when view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws game entities and updates game frame.

methods.name: getShipForId
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a ship associated with the input device ID, assigning a color based on device descriptor.

methods.name: removeShipForID
methods.description: Removes the ship associated with the given device ID.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all game entities and re-scans controllers.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Advances game state by one frame.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs game logic updates: moves entities, checks collisions, spawns obstacles.

inner_classes.name: Sprite
inner_classes.description: Abstract base class for game objects with position, velocity, size, and destruction animation.

inner_classes.name: Ship
inner_classes.description: Represents a player-controlled ship with input handling, drawing, and firing capability.

inner_classes.name: Bullet
inner_classes.description: Represents a projectile fired by ships.

inner_classes.name: Obstacle
inner_classes.description: Represents obstacles in the game field.
